name: Ponnyathankam Ankathattu & Festival Arena
historical_significance: World's only permanent traditional Ankathattu built on 25 cents of land in historic Ponniam Ezharakandam. Venue of the world's largest annual Kalaripayattu festival beginning on Kumbham 9.
govt_recognition: Rs. 8 Crores Kerala State Budget Project (Culture Dept. & Folklore Academy)

name: Ponniam Ezharakandam Historical Field
historical_significance: Historic paddy farming terrain in Ponniam celebrated in Vadakkan Pattukal ballads as the traditional arena for major martial duels (Poyth).
govt_recognition: Kerala Folklore Academy Protected Heritage Site

name: Pullodi Patyam Gopalan Memorial Reading Room & Club
malayalam_name: പുള്ളോടി പാട്യം ഗോപാലൻ സ്മാരക വായനശാല & ക്ലബ്ബ്
historical_significance: Local youth organization and library that spearheaded historical research and community funding to revive Ponnyathankam and construct the permanent Ankathattu.

name: Historic Mathiloor Kalari (Kadirur Gurukkal)
historical_significance: Seat of Mathiloor Gurukkal (Kadirur Gurukkal) who trained over 10000 disciples including Thacholi Othenan. Associated with Gurukripa and Gurukulam Kalari Sanghams.

name: Chundangapoil Ballad Memorial Site
historical_significance: Recorded in ballads as the native residence of Mayinkutty who carried out the fatal ambush of Thacholi Othenan from an ambush tunnel.

name: Kathiroor Suryanarayana Temple
historical_significance: Ancient Sun temple in Kadirur and major architectural heritage monument.

name: Lokanarkkavu Temple (Vatakara Axis)
historical_significance: Historic temple where Thacholi Othenan prayed and where the dispute sparking the Ponnyathankam duel originated.
